provenance.instrument: Harrisburg Codified Ordinances, Title 7 Part 3 Zoning Code, 7-309.2A Accessory dwelling unit (Ord. No. 6-2021), with the 7-305 Use Table, 7-307 Development Standards and 7-327 parking
provenance.status_detail: ADU criteria amended 4-13-2021 by Ord. No. 6-2021. eCode360 says the code includes legislation through 04-14-2026 and lists New Laws (0). Zoning Code adopted 7-8-2014 by Ord. No. 5-2014.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: includes legislation through 04-14-2026. New Laws (0).
checks: The definitions section uses the term 'accessory dwelling'. The use table and 7-309.2A say 'accessory dwelling unit'
Size cap is a share only: no more than 33% of the square footage of the principal residential unit. No square foot number

Density: the plain reading counts the ADU as a dwelling unit (7-333.2). RL's per-acre cap gives about 10,890 sq ft for two units. This may block many small RL and RM lots. Confirm with the Zoning Officer
No accessory structure height cap was found. A detached ADU may reach the district height (RL 36 ft, RM 45 ft). A unit inside or attached to the house also uses the district height
Off-street parking rules do not apply in the CN and DC districts (7-327.2)
A dwelling unit is occupied by only one family (7-333.2 'Dwelling unit')
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Bureau of Planning, https://harrisburgpa.gov/services/planning/index.php. A 2019 bill to drop RL and RM density limits was introduced and not passed (news report, not law). Pending changes: none found on eCode360 (New Laws 0). A city search hit mentioned a 2026 policy work session on zoning amendments. No ADU ordinance text was found. Not law.

term.note: 7-309.2A and the use table say 'accessory dwelling unit'. The definition in 7-333.2 is 'ACCESSORY DWELLING'.

status.note: By right in RL, RM, RF. Special exception in CN. Owner occupancy of the principal structure is required.

path.note: 'permitted by right in the RL, RM, and RF Zoning Districts and by special exception in the CN Zoning District'. Zoning permit from the city.

fallback_path.note: 'N' in OSR, CG, DC, INS and IND. Reading: a use variance. Relief from development standards also needs a variance (7-307.2).

value.note: 'by special exception in the CN Zoning District'. The Zoning Hearing Board decides.

zoning_districts.section: 7-309.2A and 7-305 Attachment 1 Use Table, Section C
zoning_districts.note: By right in RL, RM, RF. Special exception in CN. Use table row 'Accessory dwelling unit (7-309)' is N in OSR, CG, DC, INS, IND.

building_types.note: No building type limit. The principal residential structure must be owner-occupied.

min_lot_sqft.note: No ADU-specific lot size. Reading: the ADU counts toward district lot area per unit and density. See districts (house plus ADU).

existing_structure_only.note: 'may be created within the principal residential unit or may be located as a detached unit on the same lot'

historic_bypass.note: No historic rule in the ADU criteria. Historic overlay review (7-317) still applies to exterior work.

types_allowed.note: Text allows a unit 'within the principal residential unit' or 'a detached unit on the same lot'. Reading: an addition is part of the principal building (7-307.6C). A detached unit may be new or in an existing garage.

max_sqft.note: No square foot cap. Only the 33% share limit.

max_share_of_house.note: 'may not be larger than 33% of the square footage of the principal residential unit'

min_sqft.note: No minimum size in the ADU criteria.

max_height_ft.note: No accessory or detached ADU height cap found. 7-307.6A applies district setbacks to accessory buildings, and the only height rule is the district one (RL 36 ft, RM 45 ft). See districts.

setback_front_ft.note: 'No accessory structure, use, or building shall be permitted in a required front yard in any district'

setback_side_ft.note: 'The setback requirements of the applicable district shall apply to every accessory building'. See districts table.

setback_rear_ft.note: District rear setback applies to accessory buildings. See districts table.

internal_uses_district_height.note: A unit inside the principal unit is part of the principal building. The district principal height applies.

separation_ft.note: No separation between buildings on the same lot found. 7-307.10A(3) keeps buildings 3 ft from a parallel door or window on another lot.

max_building_coverage.note: The table sets impervious lot coverage, not building coverage.

max_impervious.note: Varies by district: RL 50%, RM 70%, CN 95%, RF 75%.

owner_occupancy.note: 'The principal residential structure shall be owner-occupied.'

family_only.note: No family or age limit in the ADU criteria.

short_term_rental_banned.note: Not addressed in the ADU criteria. Other city rental rules not reviewed.

max_adus.note: Text speaks of 'an accessory dwelling unit'. No explicit number per lot.

sale_apart_allowed.note: Not addressed. Owner occupancy of the principal structure suggests one owner, but the text does not say.

spaces_required.note: 'Accessory dwelling unit (7-309)': '1 space per unit'. Not required in CN or DC (7-327.2).

new_connection_required.note: 7-307.15 requires public water and sewer for every principal building. An ADU is accessory. Separate meters not addressed.

min_lot_sqft.section: 7-307.3A Attachment 1, Minimum Lot Area and Density, with 7-333.2 DENSITY
min_lot_sqft.note: House plus ADU, from density. Table: 5,000 sq ft and '4-8 dwelling units per acre'. Two units at 8 per acre need 43,560 / 8 x 2 = 10,890 sq ft. The code gives no per-unit lot area in RL. Reading: the ADU counts as a dwelling unit (7-333.2 DENSITY).

setback_front_ft.note: 'Minimum of 20 feet or shall conform to existing prevailing setback'. Accessory buildings may not sit in the required front yard.

min_lot_sqft.section: 7-307.3A Attachment 1, Minimum Lot Area and Density, with 7-333.2 DENSITY
min_lot_sqft.note: House plus ADU. Table: '1,500 square feet per dwelling unit', so 3,000 sq ft for two units. Reading: the ADU counts as a dwelling unit. A house alone needs 1,500 sq ft.

setback_front_ft.note: Conform to the prevailing setback in the block, or 5 ft minimum where none prevails.

setback_side_semi_ft.note: '0 feet at the shared lot line of lawfully attached dwellings'

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Per dwelling unit. An accessory dwelling is 'A separate dwelling unit' and density counts 'The total number of dwelling units'. Reading: the ADU counts.

min_lot_sqft.section: 7-307.3A Attachment 1, Minimum Lot Area and Density, with 7-333.2 DENSITY

setback_front_ft.note: Varies by street: 50 ft or 15 ft on Front Street, or existing setbacks. No single number.

setback_rear_ft.note: 15 ft for parcels along Front Street, 5 ft along State Street. No single number.

min_lot_sqft.section: 7-307.3A Attachment 1, Minimum Lot Area and Density, with 7-333.2 DENSITY
min_lot_sqft.note: House plus ADU. Table: '1,200 square feet per dwelling unit', so 2,400 sq ft for two units. Reading: the ADU counts as a dwelling unit. A house alone needs 1,200 sq ft.

setback_front_ft.note: Conform to the prevailing setback, with a maximum of 5 ft where none prevails. This is a cap, not a minimum.

parking_spaces.note: 'The off-street parking requirements in this chapter do not apply to uses within the Downtown Center or Commercial Neighborhood Zoning Districts.'

setback_side_semi_ft.note: '0 feet at the shared lot line of lawfully attached dwellings'

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Per dwelling unit. An accessory dwelling is 'A separate dwelling unit' and density counts 'The total number of dwelling units'. Reading: the ADU counts.
